name: IBM
hiring_system: IBM search service (www-api.ibm.com) behind ibm.com/careers/search; job pages on careers.ibm.com (Avature)
page_total_how: ibm.com/careers/search shows the same service's results (the page POSTs to www-api.ibm.com/search/api/v2, appId careers); its hits.total.value is the site's job count (2,216 on 2026-10-26, 246 of them level 'Internship').
notes: Reads the whole site: 23 requests of 100 (the service's maximum) sorted by _id, since the page's own order ties on every hit. Locations are 'City, CC' with ISO country codes, written out as country names ('Ehningen, DE' → 'Ehningen, Germany') so DE, IN, CO, ID are not read as US states; 'Multiple Cities' stays unsure. careers.ibm.com answers automated clients with an empty 202. See notes/ibm.md.
